recorded.prompt:q-cmf-code-to-terminal: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-cmf-code-to-terminal: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-cmf-code-to-terminal: 16.3's passed-through run shows the terminal gets nothing for a four-digit onus code (Field length 4 too long. Max: 2), because iso87ascii.xml gives field 39 two characters.
recorded.prompt:q-partial-approval: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-partial-approval: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-partial-approval: 16.4 says a code the table lacks tells the switch no more than silence, so unknownOutcome reverses what was sent and AnswerFailures answers 96.
recorded.prompt:q-continuations-off: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-continuations-off: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-continuations-off: 16.4 says that with continuations false QueryHost votes FAIL on a timeout, MapResponse never runs, and the terminal still gets its 91 while nobody reverses the purchase.
recorded.prompt:q-record-after-answer: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-record-after-answer: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-record-after-answer: 16.2 says the record is written before the request leaves because the purchase that most needs it is the one whose answer never came, and the Reference says HOST_RESPONSE is absent after a timeout.

gates.says: all 12 of this quiz's discriminating readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-cmf-code-to-terminal:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-cmf-code-to-terminal:a: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-cmf-code-to-terminal:a: 16.3 shows the terminal gets nothing for a four-digit code, ruling out a reply with 39=1001.
recorded.prompt:q-cmf-code-to-terminal:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-cmf-code-to-terminal:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-cmf-code-to-terminal:c: 16.3 puts the destination's field 39 into the reply as it is and the pack fails; translation is the switch's tables' job, not the packager's.
recorded.prompt:q-cmf-code-to-terminal:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-cmf-code-to-terminal:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-cmf-code-to-terminal:d: The quoted error is about length, and 0000 fails the same way, so the packager checks length rather than whether 1987 defines the code.
recorded.prompt:q-partial-approval:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-partial-approval:a: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-partial-approval:a: 16.4 shows an unlisted code taken for a decline (39=05, nothing queued, visa holds 1) and calls it wrong.
recorded.prompt:q-partial-approval:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-partial-approval:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-partial-approval:b: 16.3 sends every destination code through a cause and 16.4 sends an unlisted one to unknownOutcome, so 10 is never passed through.
recorded.prompt:q-partial-approval:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-partial-approval:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-partial-approval:d: 16.4's rule is to reverse what was sent, which contradicts sending the purchase again.
recorded.prompt:q-continuations-off:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-continuations-off:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-continuations-off:b: 16.4 says MapResponse never runs, so no reversal is queued.
recorded.prompt:q-continuations-off:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-continuations-off:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-continuations-off:c: 16.4 says the terminal still gets its 91.
recorded.prompt:q-continuations-off:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-continuations-off:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-continuations-off:d: 16.4 says QueryHost votes FAIL on a timeout and the terminal gets 91, so it does not wait forever.
recorded.prompt:q-record-after-answer:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-record-after-answer:a: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-record-after-answer:a: A decline is still a HOST_RESPONSE under the stem's guard, so it is recorded.
recorded.prompt:q-record-after-answer:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-record-after-answer:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-record-after-answer:c: An approval is a HOST_RESPONSE, so the guarded line records it; nothing on the page has a reply skip it.
recorded.prompt:q-record-after-answer:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-record-after-answer:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-record-after-answer:d: 16.1 and the Reference show QueryHost putting every destination's answer under HOST_RESPONSE, so the link makes no difference.
